evidence:
Built a requirement->criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md against all 53 criteria (2 gates, 43 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Coverage is very broad and mostly excellent: one-stage moves/skip (hro_move_one_stage), arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), shared manual order (hro_reorder, hro_restart), reject/reason/rejected-from/Hired/reopen/undo-restores-reason (hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired, hro_reopen), Interview places incl. bulk and undo overfill and freed place (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full), put-back+reason+focus (hro_refused_put_back), stale 409 naming who (hro_stale_refused), bulk board order/mixed stages/all-or-none (hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none), undo own last/once/conflict/note-not-a-change (hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict, hro_undo_once; a global undo stack is caught by L and B(10-11)), roles (hro_mgr_late_stages, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous 401), job/candidate intake and email rules (hro_job_open, hro_add_candidate, hro_add_email_rules, hro_candidate_linked), Activity incl. refusals/filter/newest-first (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), notes and permissions (hro_notes), live board within 15 s (hro_live_board), preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll (hro_pol_live_board) and of draft/focus in thread (hro_pol_live_thread), messages/Enter/Shift+Enter/failed send (hro_msg_compose, hro_pol_failed_send), latest 30/paging/place kept (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), unread per person/total/scrolled-up (hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up), seen incl. Observer exclusion (hro_seen), conversation access (hro_thread_access), drafts per conversation/reload/sign-out/other user (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume; note drafts in hro_pol_failed_send and hro_pol_session_resume), candidate wording/own data/no leaks/404 (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private), restart persistence and no reseeding (hro_restart). Runtime contract items (port, entry, DB_PATH, health, cwd) are exercised by test.sh launch/gates rather than criteria, which is appropriate. Bundled flows are not counted as gaps per SKILL known false positive and the Internal annotation.

GAPS (asked for, no criterion would fail an app that omits it):
(1) [P2, primary] Seeded internal notes and seeded card order are ungraded. instruction.md:15 'Load the supplied people, jobs, applications, messages, notes and read markers once'; hireops_rules.md:206-208 '`/assets/seed_data.json` holds the people, three jobs with their cards in order, the messages ..., a few internal notes and read markers. ... Load all of it once.' seed_data.json has 3 notes (e.g. APP-101 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.') and per-application `position`. Every board protocol uses the judge's own jobs (functional prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol'); hro_notes reads only newly written notes; hro_restart checks 'your jobs ... notes'; visual only looks at a seeded board for craft. Seeded messages (Noor's 120, hro_thread_latest), read markers (Lena's 1 unread, hro_unread_counts) and seeded stages of candidate applications (hro_candidate_view wording) ARE graded, so only notes and per-stage order are uncovered.
(2) [P3] Stale refusal on the user's own board: hireops_rules.md:78-80 'The person is told that the card was changed and by whom, and their board shows the card where it really is' and instruction.md:3 'tell me who'. Protocol C replays via fetch, and hro_stale_refused accepts the name 'in the response or on screen', so a UI that never displays the colleague's name on a real stale UI attempt is not graded. Likely a deliberate tool-feasibility tradeoff (a UI stale attempt races the 15 s live update); record rather than block.
(3) [P3] 'A message is plain text' (hireops_rules.md:138): no criterion sends markup to check it renders literally.
(4) [P3] 'Sending clears the draft' (hireops_rules.md:175): hro_msg_compose checks the box is empty after send but no criterion reloads/re-visits after a send to confirm the stored draft is gone.
(5) [Note] Smaller unexercised legs: a candidate's message 'seen' via the job's hiring manager (only recruiter path tested, hireops_rules.md:165-166); Observer reading Activity (rules:18); 403 and 409 status codes are not asserted (refusal is), unlike 401 which is; undo refused after another person rejects/reopens a card (only move and re-order tested, same mechanism); 'signing in does not open one for them' (rules:180-181) is enforced only indirectly via Lena's unread in hro_unread_counts. These are same-mechanism or status-detail items and are not blockers on their own.
counterexample: Plausible broken app that passes every criterion: its seeder imports users, jobs, applications (stage only, ignoring `position`, ordering seeded cards by id/name), messages and reads but skips the `notes` array. The judge never opens a seeded card's notes nor reads a seeded stage order (all board work is on its own J1/J2; hro_notes and hro_restart read only notes the judge wrote), so this app loses no points although the brief explicitly says to load the supplied notes and the jobs' cards in order. Conversely no conforming app is harmed by the gap.
suggested_fix: Add one leg (e.g. to hro_restart's pre-restart record or a small binary row) that, before any action, opens Noor Haddad's seeded Platform Engineer card as a staff user and confirms the seeded internal note is shown and the seeded Interview/other stage card order matches seed positions, and survives restart; optionally make hro_stale_refused also require the name on screen when the UI itself attempts the stale move, and add a literal-markup leg to hro_msg_compose.
